baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional joins the garment's rearward slit to the opposed predicates that she lied and he belongs among the truthful.
baseline_models.mechanism: The rear is both a physical location and an aftermath available for inspection. A longitudinal cut retained by a covering becomes an effect from which prior agency is reconstructed; separation in the object separates the accounts.

activation_trace.role: A wearable covering supplies the material surface that can retain an event.
A lengthwise slit gives the retained trace directional form.
The physical rear fixes which side of the covered body received force.
Attention to an affair's outcome activates backward inference from effect to cause.
Attribution of falsehood makes the trace adjudicate a claimant rather than merely describe damage.
Verification through fulfilled action lets a material result confirm one account.

changed_reading.before: The verse states a conditional verdict based on where a garment is torn.
changed_reading.after: The verse performs retrodiction: it reads a preserved aftermath backward to reconstruct agency and test two accounts.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The compact sequence garment, lengthwise slit, and rear makes damage carry orientation before any context is added.
baseline_models.mechanism: A slit received at the rear permits a two-vector reconstruction: the wearer departs forward while another force reaches from behind. The garment is therefore a motion record, not a static exhibit.

activation_trace.role: Agitation and leaping make the garment lexically available as a surface caught in unstable bodily motion.
Longitudinal cutting preserves a line rather than an undirected rupture.
The rear locates the applied force behind the wearer's facing direction.
Firmness and straightness lend the surviving line evidentiary stability.

changed_reading.before: The damaged garment is corroborating evidence.
changed_reading.after: The damage is a vector diagram of opposed movement, preserving who moved away and who reached from behind.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The if-then construction converts one physical state into opposed classifications of liar and truthful.
baseline_models.mechanism: The cut is both a divided path and an act of discrimination. Its orientation becomes a decision boundary that sorts incompatible narratives and their speakers.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence in time frames tear orientation as a testable event-state.
Divergent paths supply an image for the two accounts that cannot both hold.
Discriminating and separating turns the cut into an adjudicative divider.
Falsehood supplies one pole of the binary classification.
Correspondence between account and event supplies the opposing pole.

changed_reading.before: The verse gives one conclusion about two speakers.
changed_reading.after: The verse encodes a compact evidentiary procedure whose physical branch point sorts both narratives at once.

context_deltas.mechanism: Solicitation inside an involuntarily closed space becomes a race toward a boundary and an unexpected encounter there. The rear tear is generated at the transition from private coercion to public visibility, so the threshold converts hidden action into inspectable evidence.

activation_trace.role: The directional slit remains the focus-level trace produced during the transition.
Rearward location anchors the reconstructed relation between pursuer and departing body.
Solicitation supplies the interpersonal pressure inside the enclosed setting.
Coercive closure makes departure an escape from constrained space.
The door supplies the controlled passage between hidden interior and visible exterior.
Racing supplies the opposed movement needed by the rear-pull reconstruction.
The repeated door acts as the limiting boundary around the tear and encounter.
Unexpected finding at the boundary supplies the public observer before whom the trace matters.

structural_cues: 12:23 encloses the solicitation behind closed doors; 12:25 repeats the door around the rear tear and the encounter.
The 12:25 sequence is race, boundary, rear tear, encounter at the same boundary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies solicitation, coercive closure, racing, a repeated threshold, and encounter; I infer a rearward grasp during forward escape and the threshold's conversion of a private event into public evidence. A different contact mechanic remains possible, but it must still explain the directional contrast.

changed_reading.after: The tear is a threshold event: forced enclosure is breached, and the attempted restraint itself carries the hidden event into public proof.

context_deltas.mechanism: A prior proof and diversion away from evil are followed by racing and a rearward route cut into cloth. Moral redirection and bodily redirection align, making the focus trace a material afterimage of being turned away.

activation_trace.role: Cutting a route through travel lets the slit operate as a miniature path of departure.
The rear locates the material residue behind the direction of escape.
An already established proof prepares the later physical trace to function as a second mode of demonstration.
Turning something away supplies the directional change that the later rear trace materializes.
The race converts prior redirection into visible bodily motion.

structural_cues: 12:24 places proof before the diversion of evil; 12:25 immediately renders movement toward the door.
The focus preserves the result behind the body rather than restating the prior inward turning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies proof, diversion, racing, and a rearward slit; I align the moral turn with the bodily turn and read the slit as its residue. The live alternative is that the two redirections are sequential but not analogically linked.

changed_reading.before: The rear tear proves that he fled an advance.
changed_reading.after: The rear tear materially records an earlier redirection: inward refusal becomes outward departure and leaves a route behind.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding clause holds garment and cut constant while reversing orientation and verdict. Front and rear are therefore not isolated symbols but controlled alternatives; the focus conclusion gains force from the failed opposite condition.

activation_trace.role: Discrimination through separation makes orientation the test's operative variable.
Falsehood is one output of the mirrored rule.
Correspondence with the event is the opposite output of the same rule.
A sign that bears witness identifies the construction as an evidentiary test.
Face-to-face orientation supplies the controlled alternative to the focus rear.

structural_cues: 12:26 and 12:27 repeat if, garment, slit, and from, then swap front for rear and reverse both truth predicates.
The same two agents remain under test while only the damage orientation changes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored syntax and inverted verdicts; I treat the front condition as a counterfactual control that makes the rear condition relationally probative. The alternative is two customary rules merely placed side by side.

changed_reading.before: A rear tear independently indicates innocence.
changed_reading.after: The rear tear is persuasive because it is one arm of a controlled comparison whose front-facing arm predicts the opposite agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: Inspection precedes speech and the diagnosis of contrivance. The garment's condition thus transmits a report from an event no adjudicator directly witnessed, and human language is forced to answer a nonverbal statement.

activation_trace.role: The covering is the object whose condition remains available to inspection.
Reporting from another activates the rear trace as a delegated account of an unwitnessed event.
The material report exposes the prior attribution as false.
Direct sight activates the trace rather than adding another unseen claim.
A thing's indication functioning as its saying lets the garment condition operate as nonverbal testimony.
Contrivance names the verbal construction that the inspected object defeats.

structural_cues: In 12:28 seeing the garment precedes saying and the identification of contrivance.
The adjudicator enters only after the event, so the damaged object is the sole persistent participant available to sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inspection followed by speech and diagnosis; I assign the object's condition a report-like role. The alternative is that the garment merely prompts a wholly human inference and should not be personified as a witness.

changed_reading.before: A human witness applies a rule to an object.
changed_reading.after: The object acts as delegated testimony: its inspected condition speaks across the gap left by absent human observation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus successfully identifies truth, but the immediate response redirects the truthful person away and covers the offender's consequence. Later, visible signs are seen and imprisonment is still chosen. Epistemic success is therefore separated from institutional remedy.

activation_trace.role: The focus explicitly assigns falsehood, establishing that the later response is not caused by unresolved evidence.
The focus explicitly establishes correspondence between his account and the event.
Turning aside routes the vindicated person away from public consequence.
Covering an offense and shielding its bearer from effect frames the asymmetric treatment of the admitted wrong.
A newly arising opinion shows policy changing after the evidence has already appeared.
Actual seeing blocks an explanation based on simple ignorance of the signs.
Visible marks generalize the garment from one clue into a recognized field of signs.
Confinement supplies the institutional outcome imposed despite recognition.

structural_cues: 12:29 follows the visual verdict with separate commands to turn aside and seek covering.
12:35 explicitly places the decision to imprison after the signs had been seen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a resolved verdict, asymmetric commands, recognized signs, and later confinement; I infer that household power decouples knowing the truth from acting justly on it. A live alternative is that confinement serves an unstated protective aim, but the sequence still preserves the decoupling.

changed_reading.before: The material test resolves the accusation and vindicates the truthful party.
changed_reading.after: The test resolves knowledge but not power: recognized truth can be redirected, covered, and followed by confinement of its bearer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence presents refusal as protective holding, acknowledges a live capacity to incline, requests diversion, and receives an answer. Belonging among the truthful is thus enacted and preserved under pressure rather than naming effortless invulnerability.

activation_trace.role: Truth verified in action supports reading the predicate as practiced fidelity.
Stability supplies the condition that pressure threatens and protection preserves.
Protective holding presents refusal as an active means of preservation.
Requested diversion supplies the means by which pressure is kept from changing conduct.
Possible inclination of the heart keeps vulnerability materially live.
Unstable disposition names the alternative state that unchecked inclination could produce.
The answered appeal closes the causal chain by supplying effective response.

structural_cues: 12:32 reports active self-protection; 12:33 states a counterfactual vulnerability and asks for diversion; 12:34 answers by diverting the pressure.
The later first-person admission of possible inclination prevents the focus label from becoming a claim of intrinsic immunity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restraint, admitted vulnerability, requested diversion, and response; I infer that the truthful classification describes fidelity sustained through action and aid. The alternative is that the focus predicate concerns only the disputed report, not the wider durability of character.

changed_reading.before: He is classified as truthful because his account matches the event.
changed_reading.after: Truthfulness is also a protected practice: it persists through restraint, acknowledged vulnerability, appeal, and effective redirection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus places him among the truthful, while nearby clauses use the same state-plus-membership frame for sinners, the abased, and the ignorant. The verdict becomes one classification in a struggle over who may assign social and moral identity.

activation_trace.role: Being in a temporally realized state frames membership as something asserted within events.
Stable worth gives the focus classification its positive claim.
The repeated state construction begins a series of competing memberships.
Sin supplies the counter-class assigned to the other party after the verdict.
A threatened future state shows that power attempts to impose a new membership.
Abasement names the social class used to counter the focus's truthful status.
The same construction now marks a feared self-transformation.
Lack of knowledge supplies the membership he fears entering under pressure.

structural_cues: 12:27, 12:29, 12:32, and 12:33 repeatedly combine a form of being with min and a plural class label.
The labels move from evidentiary truth to fault, threatened humiliation, and feared ignorance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a concentrated recurrence of class-membership grammar; I infer that the recurrence invites comparison among judicial, imposed, and feared identities. It may alternatively be ordinary idiom without a designed taxonomy, so the social-classification layer remains medium confidence.

changed_reading.before: Among the truthful is a settled moral description.
changed_reading.after: Among the truthful is a contested membership that power tries to overwrite with abasement while the subject guards against a different inward reclassification.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first hidden struggle writes itself onto cloth; a later visual shock writes itself onto hands. Across the sequence, cuts externalize forces that speech can disguise: pursuit in the focus and overwhelming desire in the later scene.

activation_trace.role: The worn covering supplies the first affected surface.
A branch spanning cut skin, flesh, and cloth makes the later movement between textile and body materially available.
Sight supplies the later force whose effect becomes bodily visible.
Magnification within the breast mediates between seeing and involuntary action.
Severing repeats the focus's material vocabulary on living bodies.
The hand is the bodily surface that involuntarily registers the later event.

structural_cues: 12:31 orders sight, inward magnification, and cut hands in a tight causal sequence.
The pericope moves from a cut garment that exposes a denied action to cut hands that expose denied or mocked susceptibility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two conspicuous cut surfaces and a seeing-to-cut sequence; I infer a narrative analogy in which material and bodily marks disclose concealed force. The alternative is that the repeated cutting only escalates drama without creating an evidentiary series.

changed_reading.before: The torn garment is a unique forensic object.
changed_reading.after: It is the first in a sequence of involuntary inscriptions through which cloth and flesh reveal pressures that speakers can misstate.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the grammar assigns lying to the woman, while a branch of the same root names a cloth that misleads by its condition. It remains anchored in the explicit garment-plus-falsehood pairing and is useful as a reversal: a potentially deceptive surface defeats deception. Downstream prose should present this as a branch echo, not as an alternate syntactic subject or translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places a garment and the predicate of lying in the same material-verdict chain.

activation_trace.role: The garment supplies the literal cloth surface on which the reversal operates.
A cloth that deceives by its appearance activates the possibility of material false signaling.
Actual verification reverses the deceptive-cloth image: this cloth's condition authenticates rather than misleads.

changed_reading.before: The cloth neutrally reveals which speaker lies.
changed_reading.after: The scene reverses a latent deceptive-cloth image: appearance, normally able to lie, becomes the medium that exposes the fabricated appearance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-material reading is surprising because the verse reports damaged clothing, not bodily substitution. It remains anchored by branches that explicitly join cut cloth with skin or flesh and locate a sore on the back, while the later cut hands sustain the cloth-body sequence. Downstream prose should call the garment skin-like or wound-bearing, never claim a literal transferred wound.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A covering is slit at the rear while the covered body remains the object whose movement is reconstructed.

activation_trace.role: A bodily covering supports the material analogy to an outer skin.
The shared category of slit leather, flesh, and cloth bridges garment damage and bodily wounding.
A sore on the back lets the rear tear resemble a wound carried by the covering.
Later bodily severing keeps the material analogy from being isolated to one object.
The explicitly cut body part supplies a contrasting surface that bears its own event.

changed_reading.before: The garment is damaged while protecting the body.
changed_reading.after: The garment behaves like surrogate skin: it bears the rear wound and preserves that wound as testimony, before flesh itself becomes inscribed later.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the garment's branch of covering or assuming office against the surrounding economy of sale, acquisition, mastery, and threatened abasement. It remains focus-anchored in the literal torn garment and explains why a household object can expose a power relation. Downstream prose should retain it as a social-material analogy, not replace the literal garment with an abstract office.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The torn garment is a wearable cover whose branch range also permits a role or office to be put on.

activation_trace.role: Covering and assuming a role make the garment a possible shell of household status.
A piece of wealth made merchandise establishes prior conversion of the person into an owned asset.
Exchange supplies the transaction through which the household status begins.
Acquisition and taking-as convert purchase into an assigned familial or servile role.
Mastery names the household authority before whom the torn status shell is displayed.
Threatened abasement reveals the coercive social status the household can still impose after truth is known.

changed_reading.before: The garment is only a forensic possession belonging to a household dependent.
changed_reading.after: Its tear also exposes a rupture in the role imposed on a bought and mastered body: the household's status-cover can no longer conceal coercion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is deliberately form-distant: the predicate plainly means falsehood, while another branch of its root depicts an animal that runs, stops, and looks behind. It remains worth carrying because the local sequence supplies racing, a rear trace, and later seeing. Downstream prose must label it an imagistic root echo, not an alternative lexical sense of the predicate.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The word assigning falsehood stands beside a rearward motion trace whose context contains pursuit and later inspection.

activation_trace.role: Running, stopping, and looking back gives the failed account an uncanny kinetic echo.
The lasting longitudinal slit outlives the movement that produced it.
The rear supplies the direction toward which the failed pursuit is forced to look.
Racing makes the distant kinetic branch locally visible.
Later sight supplies the moment when the stopped narrative is made to face what trails behind it.

changed_reading.before: Her lie is a false proposition defeated by evidence.
changed_reading.after: As a contained root echo, the lie is also a failed pursuit: it runs briefly, stops at inspection, and is forced to look back at the trace it left.

strongest_changes: The rear tear became a retrodictive motion vector and one arm of a mirrored evidentiary control.
Closed space, racing, and threshold encounter turned private coercion into public material testimony.
Recognized truth was separated from remedy: the signs are seen, yet power redirects disclosure and later confines the truthful party.
Truthfulness became both a protected practice under live vulnerability and a membership contested by threatened abasement.
summary.what_was_special: The focus activated unusually concrete cross-domain branches: rear as both body-side and examined aftermath, cutting as route and discrimination, a garment capable of deceptive appearance, cloth contiguous with skin or flesh, and falsehood carrying a run-stop-look-back echo. These support several coexisting readings without collapsing the literal forensic test.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact rear-pull mechanics are abductive; the packet fixes orientation and racing but does not describe the hand action.
The alignment between moral diversion in 12:24 and bodily departure in 12:25 may be a compositional analogy rather than a causal design.
The surrogate-skin, torn-status, and failed-pursuit models are branch-supported outliers, not grammatical alternatives to the literal clauses.
